primary_object_card.object_statement: The primary object is a globally shared nested observation design chosen only from frozen design families to maximize exact stable-relation identifiability while preserving several compatible dynamics and several full object relations; neither hidden-rule recovery nor post-hoc held-out selection may replace that design object.
primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: The system searches for one common set of action-labelled trajectories that works across many hidden cellular-automaton dynamics. It may use exact object relations only on designated design families. It succeeds only if reserved families retain several possible dynamics and several different full object partitions while still agreeing on most queried relations.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: The inherited hash-order observation schedule crosses from underdetermination to system identification without an admitted object-consensus window.
Version-space consensus, same-probe queries, and stable behavioral equivalence remain the exact finite semantics.

native_terms.relation-directed design: A globally fixed observation subset ranked by exact train-side query consensus while model diversity is preserved.
native_terms.diversity fixture: A fixture retaining at least eight unordered dynamics hypotheses and at least two distinct full stable relations.
native_terms.query-disjoint relation: A queried state pair whose states never appear as observed predecessors or successors in that fixture packet.

weirdness_signature: the useful measurement reveals a relation without revealing one dynamics
more information can destroy the desired epistemic regime by identifying the system
the designer is target-aware and therefore cannot count as a perceiving agent
primary_object_card.domain: All 2500 size-two through size-four subsets of sixteen frozen ECA trajectories, scored on 128 train-only design fixtures
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: Three immutable size-specific observation winners, complete search hashes, and conditional validation/test regime decisions
allowed_operations: screen every candidate by exact version-space diversity
exact-score a frozen shortlist by all-compatible-model relation consensus
freeze winners before confirmation code exists
compare relation-directed, hash-order, and system-identification objectives
required_invariants: one global subset is shared by every fixture and query
primary validation families retain several hypotheses and several full relations
test reuse never becomes blind learning authority
forbidden_substitutions: aggregate coverage from identified fixtures for diversity-conditioned coverage
one favorable subset size for all three frozen size results
target-aware experimental design for spontaneous perception
a proxy score or label for the complete version-space relation object
the historically consumed v0 test block for untouched data
negative_controls: winner mutation and pre-confirmation source-presence checks
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: ECA trajectories are measurement adapters, exact stable relations are the train-side objective, and later learners are excluded. No adapter or score may replace the global design object or erase its target-aware circularity boundary.
promotion_locks: no confirmation source before the winner receipt freezes
no test opening unless two validation sizes pass
no learner or perception claim from a target-aware designer
no QIT, MMM, ontology, or cross-domain promotion
primary_object_card.artifact_surface: two-phase preregistered Codex-Ratchet packet with independent search engines, a committed winner receipt, later independent confirmation engines, controller, and fabrication audit

lateral_mappings.target: existence of a relation-identifying but dynamics-nonidentifying packet

lateral_mappings.kill_control: target-aware design alone never earns perception language

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair the first search-completeness, phase-boundary, or cross-runtime mismatch before opening confirmation
loop_contract.stop_condition: winner receipt freezes exactly or the search closes red

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: The user explicitly authorized continued implementation; the question itself is not treated as authorization.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Search ranking order and scientific content are checked separately, with the complete candidate order and tie-break named.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: Preserve the visible hash-order and system-identification baseline outputs at every frozen subset size while search and runtime code are debugged.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: The target is a diverse-model relation design; the strongest falsifier is easy-quotient engineering; the decisive check is reserved-family diversity plus coverage, classifying the target killed, open, or survived.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: The operation chooses trajectories, the observable is exact consensus conditional on residual model diversity, and the frozen gate supplies the pass/fail condition.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must refuse to merge designed measurability, learnability, perception, semantic objecthood, and general QIT claims.
method_contracts.human_offload: All finite candidate, hash, split, and score facts are resolved mechanically before asking the human.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Wizard v4.3 object-preservation guard; v4.2 is legacy/provenance only.

source_math_locks.preserves: exact finite version-space and relation-consensus semantics

sim_audit_receipts.claim_ceiling: exact finite negative observation-identifiability census only
